title: a pinned image loaded from the signed bundle is proved on either image store of the container engine
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's tests on recorded, synthetic image inspect answers of both image stores and a synthetic save archive; no container engine ran in the card's container. The install walk on hosts with major versions 28 and 29 was not run.

findings.claim: on the engine's newer image store (the container engine's default from major version 29) a loaded image's id is its manifest digest and the registry digest is not kept, so tools/image_pins.py found every digest-pinned third-party image missing and the install stopped at starting the stack (the integrator's 7168582084; the failure is reproduced on the recorded answer by test_newer_store_was_missing_before_h149)
findings.fix: the signed image-pins.json carries, read out of the saved archive, the tag, the layer diff ids and the run config; on a store where neither the digest nor the config digest resolves, the image under the tag is proved by them and compose is pointed at the store's own id; any difference is refused

findings.claim: a bundle made before this card carries pins without layers: on the newer image store it still stops at starting the stack (refused, as before); only a bundle made after this card installs there
findings.fix: the runbook's install page says so; the next signed bundle carries the layers

findings.claim: that compose starts a service from an image named by the newer image store's own id (sha256 of the manifest), with no pull, is not shown: no container engine runs in the card's container
findings.fix: the install walk on a host with major version 29 and one with 28

findings.claim: the inline Python of make_bundle.sh that wrote image-pins.json took the config digest from manifest.json without reading the config, so a pin could name an id the archive's config blob does not hash to (OCR 1525-2)
findings.fix: tools.image_pins bundle-pins, called by make_bundle.sh, refuses an archive whose config is not the content its digest names or names no layer diff ids; no pin file is written (the integrator's 7172912951)

findings.claim: the card's first write-then-rename wrote the temp file with one unchecked os.write: a disk that fills partway gave a short deploy/.env, fsynced and renamed over the whole one, truncating the generated service passwords, and the step reported success (OCR 1525-1, found in review before merge)
findings.fix: _write_atomic writes until every byte is written or raises, and removes the temp file on any failure

findings.claim: the temp file's fixed name was opened with O_CREAT|O_TRUNC: a left-over file kept its wider mode while the secrets were written, and a link planted under the name was written through and became deploy/.env (OCR 1525-3; the same on master)
findings.fix: the temp file is unlinked and made new with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, and gets its mode before any byte
